headline: Nigeria FX Demand Hits $4.67 Billion, Outpacing Central Bank Interventions
summary: Nigeria's foreign exchange trading reached $4.67 billion in the week ended November 20, as dollar demand exceeded the Central Bank of Nigeria's $1.30 billion intervention, weakening the naira.
why: Nigeria's central bank relies on foreign exchange reserves to inject dollar liquidity into domestic commercial markets.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: The naira weakened as commercial dollar demand reached $4.67 billion, outpacing central bank FX sales.
